'''Urel Haydon''' was a very dedicated [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]], and after nearly who [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of fighting, he lost multiple [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] in battle. Even though Haydon was battle hardened, he was cheerful and pleasant to be around.<ref name="Onslaught at Arda I" />
